title: Asteroid template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines an asteroid entity: a static obstacle with mass and collision shape. Per ADR-0009, every rigid body MUST have mass. Per ADR-0008, physical quantities use value+unit objects.
$comment: AGENTS: before modifying this file, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

mass.description: Asteroid mass in kilograms. Required per ADR-0009 (every rigid body MUST have mass) and ADR-0014 (gameplay values in JSON).

collision_shape.description: Collision shape for the asteroid. Defines how it interacts with other objects.

type.description: Collision shape type. 'sphere' or 'box' are supported.

radius.description: Radius of the sphere in metres (for sphere shape type).

half_extents.description: Half-extents of the box (for box shape type).

offset.description: Offset of the box center from the mesh center (for box shape type).

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box of the mesh in asteroid-local coordinates (metres). Computed once from glTF mesh. Used for debug axes and spatial calculations. Min and max are opposite corners of the box.

min.description: Minimum corner (x, y, z in metres).

max.description: Maximum corner (x, y, z in metres).
